name: Synthetic dielectric oil

sources.title: Calumet CalChill immersion cooling fluid brochure

summary: Hydrocarbon immersion fluid (gas-to-liquid or PAO class). Non-conductive and non-PFAS, with about half the heat capacity of water and several times its viscosity.

cpJPerKgK.note: CalChill 60 at 50 °C (ASTM E1269); CalChill 70 is 1935; Lubrizol CompuZol grades list 1810 to 2107.

densityKgM3.note: At 50 °C (ASTM D4052). Ester-type fluids run up to ~916 kg/m³.

viscosityPaS.note: Kinematic 7.7 cSt at 40 °C x ~830 kg/m³ = 6.4 mPa·s. CalChill 70 is 12.1 cSt.
